notablePrerequisites:
Moon-Circuit Hacker and Peregrine Drake do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Moon-Circuit Hacker or Peregrine Drake.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
description:
Declare Peregrine Drake and Moon-Circuit Hacker as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Moon-Circuit Hacker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake that is tapped and attacking.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Moon-Circuit Hacker's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moon-Circuit Hacker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Peregrine Drake tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.
